tasks.task:
Close these in r15; no id/envelope changes; blocker if impossible.
1 C5 HIGH retention-failure invariant: R5 promises <=5 retained and "evict while more than four pre-existing remain", while AC1-6 seeds five pre-existing files plus this run and makes unlink fail, requiring exactly one failure record per family. Reconcile: select the oldest excess candidates once, attempt each at most once, preserve this run's file, explicitly permit exceeding the bound when listing/unlink fails, and pin attempt counts and surviving bytes in AC1-5/AC1-6. Flag that the irreversible-deletion contract needs the affected owner's confirmation.
2 LOW anchor: replace envelope.go:200-206 with envelope.go:136-141 (validErrorInfo) in all six occurrences (spec 3/4, AC1-6, 7, 9.10, T2 inputs).
3 LOW: AC1-6 must assert resource.path equals the configured state directory.
4 LOW: correct 9.7 to the actual ticket state (mirror heading says r14; header cites r7; no sha256); drop the re-sync instruction.
5 LOW: add an R5 tie-break oracle (two conforming names sharing one parsed timestamp; assert name-ascending survivor).
6 LOW: R2 must include entries whose stat fails with a recoverable stat error (e.g. ELOOP) in the quarantine set.
7 LOW: AC1-6 emitter half is T3-owned but unlisted; add it to T3 deliverable or scope T2's AC1-6 claim to the envelope-level case.
Return the full nine-section spec and finding-to-text change log.
